summaries.name: sqlite3_column_blob
summaries.evidence: SQLite C API: returns a pointer to externally-stored BLOB bytes for the current row; length is NOT implied and must be read via sqlite3_column_bytes.
summaries.motivating_case: simdissdk SQLiteDataBaseReadUtil.cpp:336,344 — provenance died here in SECURITY-R03

summaries.name: sqlite3_column_bytes
summaries.evidence: returns the byte length of the current-row blob/text; database-derived integer, security-relevant as a bound.
